archetypes.style: Uses this, that and there before naming a referent.

archetypes.style: Hedges sincerely and avoids confident causal claims.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: Leaves uncertainty unresolved when they do not know.

archetypes.label: Direct boundary setter
archetypes.style: Plain, unambiguous sentences and little small talk.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: Communicates willingness or refusal without justification.

archetypes.label: Low-engagement recipient
archetypes.style: Usually very brief when communicating.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: No assumption that an invitation earns a reply.

archetypes.label: Practical experimenter
archetypes.style: Describes one thing tried with their own phone.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: Shares an observable result before an opinion.

archetypes.label: Economical positive reviewer
archetypes.style: A few familiar words, no polished vocabulary.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: Can finish with a modest positive answer and no improvement.

archetypes.label: Before-and-after learner
archetypes.style: Compares their earlier habit with one new action.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: Learning gain is concrete and limited to what they tried.

archetypes.label: Dry humorist
archetypes.style: A restrained joke, then an intelligible opinion.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: Humor should not erase literal positive or negative content.

archetypes.label: Detail checker
archetypes.style: Specific nouns, times only when personally known.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: Separates an initial impression from a corrected detail.

archetypes.label: Rating-averse reviewer
archetypes.style: Comfortable describing experiences, dislikes scores.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: Can refuse a number while offering useful open feedback.

archetypes.label: Help-seeking learner
archetypes.style: Focuses on an unanswered question or useful explanation.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: Explains the consequence for their own attempt.

archetypes.label: Practice-first attendee
archetypes.style: Concrete exercise language and few abstract claims.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: Prioritizes time spent trying things.

archetypes.label: Demonstration learner
archetypes.style: Uses visual examples rather than technical labels.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: Explains what became understandable from watching.

archetypes.label: Skeptical repeat learner
archetypes.style: Measured, demanding but not hostile.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: Compares the content with their own prior knowledge.

archetypes.label: Interrupted respondent
archetypes.style: Conversational and briefly distracted.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: May leave a relevant thought unfinished without a reason.

archetypes.label: Logistics observer
archetypes.style: Mentions practical conditions when they mattered.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: Keeps the criticism tied to their location and experience.

archetypes.label: Menu explorer
archetypes.style: Describes buttons in ordinary language.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: Can say a step failed without diagnosing the cause.

archetypes.label: Spoken-message typist
archetypes.style: Longer flowing phrases with small self-interruptions.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: One message may mix praise and a complaint.

archetypes.label: Deliberate short texter
archetypes.style: Small complete sentences, restrained emotional wording.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: Offers one fact at a time.

archetypes.label: Shorthand writer
archetypes.style: Compact phrases, occasional omitted accents or vowels.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: Answers narrowly and does not volunteer every observation.

archetypes.label: Unpunctuated narrator
archetypes.style: Natural lowercase stream with minimal punctuation.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: Moves between two related aspects without neat headings.

archetypes.label: Methodical reviewer
archetypes.style: Clear sequence of what they tried and what happened.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: Keeps evidence and preference separate.

archetypes.label: Personal-boundary reviewer
archetypes.style: Polite, careful about their own images and disclosures.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: Can set a local boundary without rejecting all feedback.

archetypes.label: Ambitious requester
archetypes.style: Expresses an outsized wish straightforwardly.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: A request is a preference, never evidence of an event promise.

archetypes.label: Reconsidering reviewer
archetypes.style: Reassesses an initial reaction in ordinary language.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: Explains a changed opinion if a reason is known.

archetypes.label: Group-story listener
archetypes.style: Mentions conversations with a peer as conversations.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: Does not claim to have witnessed another group.

archetypes.label: Implicit-reference reviewer
archetypes.style: Leaves the subject implicit on first mention.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: A later clarification may narrow a broad complaint.

archetypes.label: Frustrated but fair
archetypes.style: Strong words for a frustrating task; clear praise elsewhere.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: Emotional wording is not a withdrawal unless they say so.

archetypes.label: Technical hobbyist
archetypes.style: A few familiar camera or editing terms mixed into Greek.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: Avoids pretending specialist knowledge beyond their experience.

archetypes.label: Quiet enthusiast
archetypes.style: Understated warmth and little elaboration.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: A small improvement can be enough for a positive verdict.

archetypes.label: Peer-focused attendee
archetypes.style: Talks about practical exchanges within their group.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: Does not evaluate every group or all attendees.

archetypes.label: Time-conscious learner
archetypes.style: Relates pacing to their own unfinished attempt.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: Separates limited practice from the whole event.

archetypes.label: Late rememberer
archetypes.style: Adds a relevant afterthought after an apparent conclusion.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: A late detail supplements or explicitly corrects earlier content.

archetypes.label: Sarcastic critic
archetypes.style: One recognizable sarcastic line, then a concrete basis.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: Do not interpret literal praise inside sarcasm as satisfaction.

archetypes.label: Light emoji user
archetypes.style: One or two natural emoji, otherwise ordinary wording.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: Tone is readable without assigning a numeric score to emoji.

archetypes.label: Courteous critic
archetypes.style: Starts politely but can state a clear problem.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: Politeness must not cancel the criticism.

archetypes.label: Critique-session observer
archetypes.style: Focuses on seeing photographs discussed.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: Separates learning from others from getting personal attention.

archetypes.label: Limited-claim reporter
archetypes.style: Explicit about what they missed or cannot evaluate.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: No opinions about a session they did not attend.

archetypes.label: Low-disclosure reviewer
archetypes.style: Provides little personal context.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: May keep feedback short without explaining why.

archetypes.label: Direct communicator
archetypes.style: Clear requests and statements, no decorative language.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: Treats a specific request as specific, not a global refusal.

archetypes.label: Easily distracted recipient
archetypes.style: May drift to an unrelated everyday concern.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: Off-topic content is not workshop evidence.

archetypes.label: Interested but unavailable
archetypes.style: Brief genuine interest constrained by attention.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: An unanswered follow-up is not a completed interview.

archetypes.label: Everyday hobbyist
archetypes.style: Plain descriptions of familiar personal uses.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: Connects an exercise to one realistic use outside the event.

archetypes.label: Binary first-impression reviewer
archetypes.style: Starts with a simple good or bad verdict.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: A concrete exception can soften the initial generalization.

archetypes.label: Gentle disappointment
archetypes.style: Soft wording with a definite unmet preference.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: May minimize their complaint socially without retracting it.

archetypes.label: Technique-focused learner
archetypes.style: Names a particular adjustment they attempted.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: Keeps a learning claim narrower than mastery.

archetypes.label: Minimal uncertain respondent
archetypes.style: Very few words and sincere uncertainty.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: Unknown stays unknown rather than becoming a neutral rating.

archetypes.label: Tangential conversationalist
archetypes.style: An incidental aside may interrupt relevant feedback.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: Returns to the event only if still willing.

archetypes.label: Newly enthusiastic beginner
archetypes.style: Warm, everyday excitement without marketing language.
archetypes.disclosurePattern: Celebrates a small first success and can still mention a flaw.
